newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 1996 insurance premium income up 20.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 1996 insurance premium income up 20.1 pct.

text.p: Total premium income of Malaysia's insurance industry grew by an estimated 20.1 percent to 9.5 billion ringgit in 1996 from 7.9 billion ringgit in 1995, the central bank said on Monday.

At end-1996, total insurance fund assets reached 30.1 billion ringgit, up from 25.0 billion at end-1995, Bank Negara said in its 1996 insurance annual report. They comprised 20.7 billion ringgit in life insurance funds and 9.4 billion general insurance funds.
